Prompt.Prompt: EF-REG-022 - Over-threshold submission creates one linked approval task

parameters.elementDescription: The 'Open expense' link inside the fresh EXP-1039 card in the CENTER area, below the Approval reason and above the Comments box; this link belongs to EFREG022-ApprovalLink-EFQA-20260925T1245, not the neighboring EFREG023 card to the right.

parameters.script: const text=document.body.innerText; const nodes=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('body *')).filter(e=>{const t=(e.innerText||'').trim(); return t && (t.includes('ApprovalTaskId')||t.includes('101661275')||t.includes('Pending Approval')||t.includes('Waiting on a manager'));}).slice(0,30).map(e=>({tag:e.tagName,text:(e.innerText||'').trim().slice(0,500),attrs:Array.from(e.attributes||[]).reduce((o,a)=>(o[a.name]=a.value,o),{})})); return {href:location.href,body:text.slice(0,4000),matches:nodes};
